section_summary.extract_value: This section presents convergent validity results for the BAS-2, showing that greater body appreciation was significantly associated with higher self-esteem and life satisfaction. Notably, body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI among women but positively correlated among men, with a significant correlation of r = .12 (p = .006) found between body appreciation and BMI² in men, suggesting a possible curvilinear relationship.
